_readme: Per-locale reel captions + outro tagline. gen_scenes.py stamps these into scenes_<locale>.json,
reusing the English scenes.json for timing, canvas, style and the scene KEYS — only the words
change, because the timing aligns to the demo tour and must not drift per language.
Reel captions are tighter than screenshot captions: they sit in a 22% caption band over a
moving frame and are on screen for 4-5 seconds. A line that wraps to three lines is unreadable
at that length, so these are shorter than the equivalent lines in ../captions.json.

scenes: Ein volles Horoskop für jeden Moment
